_comment: Optional. Copy to ha_webhook.json to also drive a light WLED can't reach (here a Bluetooth-only BanlanX SP630E via Home Assistant). Every apply/white/off POSTs {phase, power, bri, kelvin} to this local-only webhook; home-assistant/automation.banlanx_webhook.yaml applies it. bri comes from the phase's bri_white. Delete the file to stop.
